title: Microscopic boundary, prefixes and longest runs
summary: The exact left-border probability is 2^(-pi(L)), and the microscopic non-vacancy probability satisfies 0 <= q_L/2^(-pi(L)) - 1 <= 2^(-pi(L)/256) for sufficiently large L. The results give conditional localization and uniqueness, stability under changes of mesoscopic cutoff, and a quantitative Poisson law for runs contained in a finite prefix. They yield the critical longest-run distribution and asymmetric almost-sure envelopes for all integer prefix lengths. The exact border identity needs no literature hypothesis.
